items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: He said, '...she is suddenly in a class with Ethel Waters, Fanny Brice, and Peggy Lee.'

ctx.x: What did Dicky have to say?
"Hey Homey". Earle Warren and them, Well, /they used to call me Fanny. They used to call me Fat Fanny, because I had a little bitty waist line, you know, and kind of big hips and legs.
